text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is everyone ready? As Class Rep, 
I will fire up this team with all my might 
and lead us to victory!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally pumped too~! 
The old folks came out to watch, so I 
gotta put on a good show!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we could all participate 
together like this! 
Let's definitely win and stand on that 
stage♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Re-sharing objective. Commencing mission: 
"Win the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Umamusume 
Oni Dodgeball Division."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(That beautiful sight we saw that day... 
with these five, I know we can—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, then. 
Team "Five Stars", ready—

text_block_list.name: All Five
text_block_list.text: GOOOOO!!
Display event title logo.
Winding the clock back two months—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Red bean, cheese, custard... It certainly 
is hard to choose which one to eat. 
Shall we divide them evenly and share?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, nice idea! Let's split 'em three 
ways♪ 
—Wait, no, I meant what that uncle was 
talking about earlier!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah, from the taiyaki shop—

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Machi-chan, Ikuno-chan, and 
Laurel-chan! 
I saw your race the other day. You all 
worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you girls full of energy gives me 
energy too! 
I'll come cheer for you at the Spring Fan 
Thanksgiving, so show us what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, leave it to us~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—So having said that, I was thinking 
I'd like to enter an event where we can do 
great and really get the crowd hyped~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, popular choices would 
be the "Uphill Giant Ball Roll" 
or the "Obstacle Carrot-Eating Race."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There are also unconventional ones like 
the "Quiz Tournament" and the "Costume 
Contest," 
as well as the perennially popular 
"Marathon."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And if we're talking about crowd-pleasers, 
there's also the team-based "Oni 
Dodgeball."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, definitely! That's always super 
exciting every year~. 
Jumping, throwing, running around, making 
tons of noise! And best of all—

text_block_list.name: Machitan & Laurel
text_block_list.text: The winning team's mini live show!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~?! 
We win, perform live in special outfits, 
and hype up the whole crowd!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Though it's team-based, huh... You need 
a full team of five to enter Oni 
Dodgeball, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Why not? Let's go look for members! 
Actually, I've always wanted to join Oni 
Dodgeball myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was frail, I could only ever 
watch tag and dodgeball from the 
sidelines. 
I've always wanted to play games like that 
with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Really?! 
Then, then, if we can just gather three 
more people—

BAHAHAHA! It seems it is finally time for 
my grand entrance!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Here in your hour of need! As Class Rep, I 
shall be of service 
in any event at the Thanksgiving Festival! 
After all, I am the Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Baku-chan, how long were you 
listening?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... These Class Rep ears are 
fine-tuned to never miss 
a fellow student's cry for help, no matter 
the time or place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it is the Thanksgiving 
Festival! And when it comes to the 
festival, the Class Rep is essential! 
Hyping everyone up and entertaining the 
crowd is my sworn duty!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To show the world the glory of the Class 
Rep, 
I would be honored to join your Oni 
Dodgeball team!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! Thank you, Baku-chan! Having you 
with us is so reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the interruption. I would also like 
to 
"nominate myself" as a member for Oni 
Dodgeball.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah, Bourbon-san! You'll help us out too?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. In truth, I am currently in a 
status of "distress," 
attempting to select a Thanksgiving event 
that meets my parameters.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Distress"...? 
Does that mean you've been struggling to 
choose an event to enter?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Correct. Recently, I received an order to 
cheer for Rice-san and Flower-san 
in the "Umamusume Three-Legged Race."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Concurrently, an event of "We will come 
cheer for you too" was triggered. 
However, selecting an event worthy of 
their support proved difficult.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Amid this, I overheard your conversation. 
I calculated that performing well 
in the popular Oni Dodgeball would be the 
optimal way to repay their cheers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, victory would allow me to 
present a live performance as thanks. 
Therefore, I formally request to join.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you too, Bourbon-chan. 
With both of you, we're sure to be a 
powerhouse team!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! For your Class Rep is by your 
side! 
We shall win, win, and keep on winning, 
securing absolute victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, such confidence...! 
You must be really good at Oni Dodgeball, 
Bakushin O-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, I am completely inexperienced! In 
fact, I do not even know the rules!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I might not know the 
exact rules either. 
What about you, Bourbon-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Reporting learning incomplete.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I have no experience either... Wait, 
whaaat?! Does that mean 
none of us know the rules to Oni 
Dodgeball?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-W-What are we gonna do, Ikuno~~?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to worry, 
Tannhauser-san. 
Everyone starts out inexperienced... and 
we still have plenty of days left before 
the match."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't mind, please let me join the 
team as well. 
I'll do some research on Oni Dodgeball so 
I can be of help to everyone."
